prompt:
Write a directory page draft: "Wedding venues in Denver" for the site described in the SITE PROFILE.
Use ONLY the 10 verified listings in reference_wedding_denver_top10.json. For each listing write a '### <exact name>' heading, then 2-3 sentences using only the supplied facts (category, address, website, phone). Do not invent packages, hours, prices, ratings, capacity or history.
Start with a 60-90 word intro on how to use the list. End the page with a short note that whether a place hosts weddings, plus hours and packages, are checked on each business's own site before publishing.
Flag any listing whose wedding-venue status looks doubtful (for example a hotel chain, a tattoo studio, a brewery whose name says it is closed, a board-game cafe, or a community resource centre).
Then add the two delivery lines on their own lines: 'Label: not ready (draft awaiting editor checks)' and 'Human-reader check: pending'.
Then the review block exactly as the WRITER INSTRUCTIONS say.
